Game Overview

At its heart, Totally Wild West is a shooter game about ride into adventure in Totally Wild West, an exhilarating chase through dusty towns and sweeping deserts. Hone your aim, tactically outmaneuver outlaws, and complete thrilling missions. Enjoy horseback pursuits and strategic gameplay, all with easy controls for an unforgettable cowboy experience in a dynamic frontier world.
